tiles.title: Security Events Timeline
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by bin(Timestamp, 1m), EventType
| render timechart

tiles.title: Events by Person
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by PersonID
| join kind=inner (print PersonID = dynamic([1,2,3,4,5]), PersonName = dynamic(['Julian Croft','Evelyn Reed','Marcus Thorne','Anya Sharma','Dr. Alistair Finch']) | mv-expand PersonID to typeof(int), PersonName to typeof(string)) on PersonID
| project PersonName, EventCount
| render barchart

tiles.title: Events by Location
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by LocationID
| extend LocationName = case(
    LocationID == 101, "Julian's Study",
    LocationID == 102, "Server Room",
    LocationID == 103, "Evelyn's Suite",
    LocationID == 104, "Marcus's Suite",
    LocationID == 105, "Back Path",
    LocationID == 106, "Dr. Finch's Suite",
    "Unknown")
| project LocationName, EventCount
| render piechart

tiles.title: Suspicious Events
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| where IsSuspicious == true
| project Timestamp, PersonName, LocationName, EventType = AccessType, Details
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 50

tiles.title: Communications Timeline
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize MsgCount = count() by bin(Timestamp, 1m), Channel
| render timechart

tiles.title: Communication Network
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize MessageCount = count() by SenderName, ReceiverName
| order by MessageCount desc

tiles.title: Message Sentiment
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize Count = count() by Sentiment
| render barchart

tiles.title: Recent Messages
tiles.query:
Communications
| project Timestamp, SenderName, ReceiverName, Channel, MessageSnippet, Sentiment
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 50

tiles.title: Audience Votes
tiles.query:
Votes
| summarize VoteCount = count() by Suspect
| order by VoteCount desc
| render barchart

tiles.title: Average Confidence by Suspect
tiles.query:
Votes
| summarize AvgConfidence = avg(Confidence), VoteCount = count() by Suspect
| order by VoteCount desc
| render barchart

tiles.title: Recent Audience Guesses
tiles.query:
Votes
| project Timestamp, Suspect, Confidence, Motive
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 25
